trigger.note: Fires when the crew has walked 6 minutes of its solar-storm route. The crew takes its first step 60 s (reactS) after the storm alert, so at_s = 60 (sep-1) + 60 + 360 = 480. The engine holds the mission clock at that instant, whatever the demo pacing.
One Mars sol after the solar event; the mission clock jumps forward.
